description_en: Terminates a SQL result set export task
description_zh: 调用此接口可以终止SQL结果集导出任务
name: PauseDataExportJob

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the DMS console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户的ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ticket ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html operation to query the ticket ID
parameters.help_zh: 工单ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SQL result set export task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465911.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter. If you set this parameter to Null, no SQL result set export task is suspended
parameters.help_zh:
SQL任务ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465911.html获取JobId字段值。
如果字段值为Null，则说明未有导出任务生成
parameters.name: job_id
